subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 259 (CMBA-15). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From MT-INFO: S-SH and C-CONT (composite continuance). From INFO-AF-B: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From C-CONT: BIA (bi-aitional) and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). From BIA: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics).
